package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/jsonpb"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
)

func TestPulseUnscoped(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("PULSE_ORACLE_DIR")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Fatal("PULSE_ORACLE_DIR required")
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	all := &tempopb.Trace{}
	var rows []*Trace
	for i := 1; i <= 6; i++ {
		r := batch(i, "frontend", "request", 1, 0, uint64(100+i)*1000000000, uint64(100+i)*1000000000+1000000)
		s := r.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0]
		s.Status = &tv.Status{}
		if i != 2 && i != 6 {
			r.Resource.Attributes = append(r.Resource.Attributes, value("shared", "resource"))
		}
		if i == 2 || i == 3 {
			s.Attributes = append(s.Attributes, value("shared", "span"))
		}
		if i == 4 {
			s.Attributes = append(s.Attributes, &cv.KeyValue{Key: "shared", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_IntValue{IntValue: 7}}})
		}
		if i == 5 {
			s.Attributes = append(s.Attributes, value("shared", "resource"))
		}
		s.Attributes = append(s.Attributes, value("other", "yes"))
		tr := &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{r}}
		all.ResourceSpans = append(all.ResourceSpans, r)
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, s.TraceId, tr, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	type Case struct {
		Query      string `json:"query"`
		Start, End uint32
		Response   json.RawMessage `json:"response"`
	}
	queries := []string{
		`{ .shared = "resource" }`,
		`{ .shared = "span" }`,
		`{ .shared = "resource" && span.other = "yes" }`,
		`{ .shared = "resource" || span.other = "yes" }`,
		`{ .shared =~ "resource" }`,
		`{ .shared != "span" }`,
		`{ .shared !~ "span" }`,
		`{ .shared = 7 }`,
	}
	cases := []Case{}
	for _, q := range queries {
		for _, bounds := range [][2]uint32{{99, 200}, {0, 0}} {
			q := q + " with (most_recent=true)"
			response, err := traceql.NewEngine().ExecuteSearch(context.Background(), &tempopb.SearchRequest{Query: q, Start: bounds[0], End: bounds[1], Limit: 100, SpansPerSpanSet: 3}, traceql.NewSpansetFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, req traceql.FetchSpansRequest) (traceql.FetchSpansResponse, error) {
				return block.Fetch(ctx, req, common.DefaultSearchOptions())
			}))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			response.Metrics = nil
			for _, tr := range response.Traces {
				for _, ss := range tr.SpanSets {
					for _, sp := range ss.Spans {
						sort.Slice(sp.Attributes, func(i, j int) bool { return sp.Attributes[i].Key < sp.Attributes[j].Key })
					}
				}
			}
			out, err := (&jsonpb.Marshaler{}).MarshalToString(response)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			cases = append(cases, Case{q, bounds[0], bounds[1], json.RawMessage(out)})
		}
	}
	wire, err := proto.Marshal(all)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/input.protobuf", wire, 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out, err := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/oracle.json", append(out, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("cases=%d", len(cases))
}
